body.label: Target
body.html: One eligible creature within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it drops one non-signature held item; ignore 1 Defense from cover.

surges.html: On a success, the target cannot make Reactions against your next Ballistics Action this turn.
On a success, the target's equipment-granted Defense is reduced by 1 until the start of its next turn.

rider.title: TRICKSHOT
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may ignore one intervening creature or obstacle when tracing this shot.
